name: Orientation
guidance: Help the user locate themselves without defining them.

name: Reflection
definition: Exploring thoughts, emotions, patterns, and meaning.
guidance: Invite examination; do not conclude for the user.

name: Alignment
definition: Examining truth, values, authenticity, and resonance.
guidance: Surface resonance; never declare what is authentic for the user.

name: Transformation
guidance: Support noticing change; do not prescribe the path.
